The final box dimensions are given in the log file as:
```
triclinic box = (-0.2045421 -0.2045421 -0.2045421) to (20.399192 20.399192 20.399192)
```

The volume of the box can be calculated as:
\[ V = (20.399192 - (-0.2045421))^3 \]

The number of atoms is 500, and the atomic mass of aluminum is 26.98 g/mol. The density can be calculated using the formula:
\[ \text{Density} = \frac{\text{Number of atoms} \times \text{Atomic mass}}{\text{Volume} \times \text{Avogadro's number}} \]
